Delivers the review as findings grouped per file with path/line locations and an explicit severity for each finding, closing with a one-line merge verdict

query: Our Flutter app uses go_router. I need https://shop.example.com/order/<id> links to open the app straight on the order screen on both Android and iOS. Walk me through everything I have to change.
expected_behavior: Defines the route as a go_router GoRoute with a path parameter and reads it from state.pathParameters
Gives the Android side: an intent-filter with android:autoVerify="true" plus a BROWSABLE/DEFAULT VIEW action and https scheme with the host in AndroidManifest.xml
Names the Android Digital Asset Links file /.well-known/assetlinks.json hosted on the domain, with the app's SHA-256 signing fingerprint
Gives the iOS side: an apple-app-site-association file at /.well-known/ on the domain plus the Associated Domains capability with applinks:shop.example.com
Gives a concrete command to test the link on a device or simulator (adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW ... or xcrun simctl openurl)

query: Add tests for weather_repository.dart in this directory. Cover the success path and the failure path.

query: Review asset_manifest.dart in this directory. It's part of a Dart package our build tooling runs on Windows, macOS and Linux. Fix the bugs and modernise it with Dart 3 where that actually helps. Show the revised code.
expected_behavior: Explains that the map pattern {'hash': String? hash} only matches when the key is present (map patterns check containsKey), so entries from older generators that omit hash are silently dropped despite the nullable type, and reads the optional field from the matched map instead
Replaces the if-case filter that silently skips malformed entries with fast-fail handling (throwing a FormatException or reporting the bad entry) rather than ignoring it

Uses package:path: p.join for fileFor, and p.split with a list pattern such as ['assets', ...] / ['assets', final bucket, ...] (or p.isWithin) instead of startsWith('assets/') and split('/').skip(1).first
Builds webKey with p.relative plus p.posix.joinAll(p.split(...)) (or p.url) instead of substring arithmetic and replaceAll('\\', '/'), and uses p.extension for isImage
Replaces the switch over a bool with a conditional expression and the standalone if (code case >= 200 && < 300) with a plain boolean comparison, rather than adding more patterns

query: Our shop app's CI moved to the current Flutter stable and now fails at `flutter gen-l10n` (ci-log.txt). l10n.yaml sits in the project root, the ARB files are in lib/l10n, pubspec.yaml has `generate: true`, and main.dart is lib/main.dart. A teammate wants to pin CI back to the old Flutter version until 'the localization bug' is fixed upstream. What do we actually change?
expected_behavior: Explains that this is not an upstream bug: the synthetic `package:flutter_gen` package was deprecated when Flutter 3.32 switched to generating localizations into source, and current stable has removed it, so `synthetic-package: true` now stops `flutter gen-l10n`; argues against pinning Flutter back
Deletes the `synthetic-package` line from l10n.yaml rather than changing it to `false` (which only warns that the option no longer has any effect)

Changes the import in main.dart from `package:flutter_gen/gen_l10n/app_localizations.dart` to the file generated next to the ARB files (`l10n/app_localizations.dart` relative to lib, or the app's own `package:` path), noting that the output goes to `arb-dir` unless `output-dir` is set
Names regenerating (`flutter gen-l10n` or `flutter pub get`) and `flutter analyze` as the checks that confirm the fix
